{{Quote|The first squad I commanded after making sergeant was sent to free POWs being held at a small Imperial outpost. Intel said the place would be lightly manned. Most of the Imperials wouldn't arrive for another twenty-four hours.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="Bad Intel" />}}
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] maintained a small '''outpost''', where they held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Bad Intel" /> Sometime between [[3665 BBY]]<ref name="Date">According to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', [[Elin Garza]] enlisted at the age of 15 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] using false credentials, meaning that the minimum age for enlistment must be higher than 15. Therefore, as Fideltin Rusk did not enlist illegally, he must have been older than 15 at the time of the attack, and Rusk was born in [[3680 BBY]].</ref> and the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1" /> a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Surgeons|squad]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|attacked]] the outpost in order to rescue the prisoners, basing their assault on intelligence that stated the base's reinforcements would not arrive for another [[Time/Legends|day]]. However, the reinforcements arrived early, giving the base's personnel a significant advantage over the attackers. Despite the enemy's superior numbers, the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was successful in rescuing the prisoners and escaped the base with no [[Death/Legends|fatalities]] on their side. Rusk would later mention the outpost while telling the story of the mission to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="Bad Intel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial outpost was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the conversation "Bad Intel" with the companion character Sergeant Rusk for the Jedi Knight class. The conversation does not specify the base's location.<ref name="Bad Intel" />
